payload.title: Robust U-surface projection improves deployment bases without unacceptable tail risk
payload.statement: Projecting predicted U=TVT+Z toward a robust low-frequency polynomial surface can improve the frozen deployment families while preserving repeated-fold and tail stability.
payload.evidence_for: The 50% projection improved aggregate RMSE on the tested bases and confirmed that the low-frequency U surface contains useful structural signal.
payload.evidence_against: The frozen 50% action failed tail-concentration and repeated-family gates, including the E011 family, so aggregate improvement was not promotion evidence.
payload.next_test: Run one preregistered lower-strength replication focused on tail safety rather than retuning after results.
